In the US, companies can buy and sell our personal data without our knowledge or consent. It sounds unbelievable, but it is reality.

In theory, you can ask companies to delete your data from the internet, but it is far easier said than done. Fortunately, Incogni offers a service to handle it for you, and 9to5Mac readers can now enjoy an exclusive 45% discount……

Your personal data is being sold

Apple offers several features to help us protect our online privacy, including App Tracking Transparency, Hide My Email, and iCloud Private Relay. Making good use of these tools can help reduce our public digital footprint online.

But these features cannot handle data that has already been leaked. Most people are shocked when they learn that marketers and scammers can find out how much information they have just by buying data from data brokers.

When you download a new app or sign up for a new website, those 30-page terms and conditions often contain clauses that seem harmless, such as authorising the sharing of data with select partners. In reality, sensitive data such as location history may be sold to data brokers and then resold to anyone who can pay.

Data brokers collect personal data from multiple sources to build detailed personal profiles. Businesses can buy this data to send you spam. Even worse, if scammers obtain this information, they can impersonate organisations you are familiar with to gain your trust for fraudulent purposes.

Delete your family’s data

In most US states, you have the legal right to request the deletion of your data from these databases. Unfortunately, because there are hundreds of companies involved, the entire process is extremely time-consuming.

Without exception, these companies deliberately make the procedure complicated and intimidating. For example, you cannot submit a single application on behalf of your whole family — each family member must apply separately. Opt-out forms are often hard to find, and sometimes lengthy and complex application forms must be filled out.

Even if you succeed, you will still need to repeat the same process regularly in the future, because there is no mechanism to stop them from buying your new data again.

Fortunately, Incogni offers a more convenient solution

The good news is that Incogni can automate the entire process for you. After setting up an account, it only takes a few clicks to start the process for your whole family.

Incogni will contact hundreds of data brokers on behalf of you and your family to request the removal of your data. The company will not only handle it once, but will also do it regularly to ensure your family’s data does not reappear in these databases.

The result is that you will receive significantly fewer spam messages and robocalls, and the chances of being targeted by scammers will be greatly reduced.
